title: Cross-Desk Note with the Finance Desk on the Share of a Metal Movement Passed On
content:
# Cross-Desk Note with the Finance Desk on the Share of a Metal Movement Passed On

60 per cent of a movement in the metal market, 85 per cent of it, or the whole of it is passed on to the customer on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. Which of the three follows turns on whether a promotional financing plan the customer holds with the chain finances the till transaction the commission was written on, and on whether that plan's promotional term has ended.

## The shares

| Where | The share passed on |
|---|---|
| A promotional financing plan held with the chain finances the till transaction the commission was written on and that plan's promotional term has not ended | 60 per cent of the movement |
| Such a plan finances that till transaction and its promotional term has ended | 85 per cent of the movement |
| Otherwise | The whole of the movement is passed on |

## Where the records are

The till transaction the commission was opened on stands on the commission record. Whether a plan finances that same till transaction, and the last day of the promotional term carried by that plan, are held under Belrose Promotional Financing Plans against that same till transaction. The promotional term has not ended while that last day falls after the day the repricing is booked, and has ended once that day has been reached or passed.

## Readings (hypothetical)

On a movement of USD 500.00, with the repricing booked on the 20th of June:

- A plan on the same till transaction whose promotional term runs to the 30th of September: 60 per cent, that is USD 300.00.
- A plan on the same till transaction whose promotional term ran to the 31st of May: 85 per cent, that is USD 425.00.
- A plan on the same till transaction whose promotional term runs to the 20th of June: the last day has been reached, so 85 per cent, that is USD 425.00.
- No plan on that till transaction: the whole of the movement is passed on, USD 500.00.
